name: TagGroup
summary: A wrapping row of tags with a label: none, one or several can be selected, and each can be removed.

a11y.keyboardNote: One Tab stop for the group (the active tag); arrows move between tags, Home and End go to the ends. With selection each tag is a toggle button (aria-pressed) in a group; without, a list. Delete or Backspace removes the active tag; the X is for the pointer and is not a Tab stop (without selection, the X buttons are the stops).

props.name: label
props.description: REQUIRED. The group's name. labelHidden keeps it for screen readers only.

props.name: labelHidden
props.description: Hides the label from the screen, not from screen readers.

props.name: selectionMode
props.description: none: a list. single/multiple: each tag toggles (aria-pressed); the selected one is in the light yellow wash.

props.name: selectedKeys / defaultSelectedKeys
props.description: The selected ids, controlled or not.

props.name: onRemove
props.description: With it each tag gets the X, and Delete/Backspace remove the active one; the focus goes to the neighbour.

props.name: description
props.description: Help under the tags, in aria-describedby.

props.name: errorMessage
props.description: The error under the tags, in aria-describedby.

props.name: variant
props.description: The neutral fill, or the card fill (for a tag on a grey surface).
